task: Ownership workstream: lexical borrow inspection and runtime embedding

facilities.contract: Borrow tag, identifier operand, shared/exclusive flags and referent type syntax are retained from the canonical parser. No semantic admission is conferred.

Checked lexical borrow expressions, borrow/ref parameters and exclusive stores retain their mode without changing referent types or record layouts. Wire-v1 inspection validates mode/operand structure and remains candidate-only.

An unchanged ABI-1 scalar export calls generated C11 code which boxes a Cell, reborrows it, replaces and reads the payload, drops the owner, and returns a scalar. Signature and call validation reject unsupported owner-like value tags/flags; no general transport.

limits: No canonical checker, backend admission, private generated ABI, or public On1xRT ABI changes.
Old HIR-v1 payloads cannot recover omitted shared parameter flags; older readers reject the new flags and expression kind.
No On1x own<T> or lexical loan crosses the embedding ABI; private C11 fatal errors remain terminal. The module is not sandboxed.
